sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS We estimate that the net proceeds from this offering will be approximately $70.0 million, or approximately $80.5 million if the underwriters exercise in full
their option to purchase up to 10,714,285 additional shares of common stock, after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us. We will receive nominal proceeds, if any, upon exercise of the
pre-funded warrants. We currently intend to use the net proceeds from this offering primarily to fund the commercial launch of VOCERYQ, for the development of our
